verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a code-first engine shipped as NPM ES6 modules, so projects can be built through ordinary scripted JS tooling with no editor clicks. Its docs also cover server-side use and a NullEngine for headless execution. The pack does not document a Babylon-specific build or export command or any CI workflow, so the build step rests on generic npm tooling. Missing for 10: a documented first-party CLI build/export pipeline, explicit CI/headless build guidance, and hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can build and export the project from the command line, headless, in CI — no human clicking an editor

citations.quote: Modular design with tree-shakable ES6 modules
Framework packages, NPM support, ES6 modules
